name: SDLC Modernization - Search & Propose
description: Example workflow demonstrating the code-intel integration added 2026-07-20. Given a natural-language description of a legacy pattern (e.g. a deprecated API, an outdated library usage, a security anti-pattern), it semantically searches the tenant's indexed codebase for matches (search_code), then hands the results to an analysis agent that can follow up with code_callers/code_impact/code_callees/code_graph_stats to reason about blast radius, and produces a written migration proposal. READ-ONLY end to end - it stops at 'here is the plan', deliberately, because the write/execute half (create a workspace, apply a fix, run tests) exists in the codebase as of today but is NOT YET wired to any agent - see docs/SDLC-CODEINTEL-INTEGRATION-2026-07-20.md for exactly what that means and what's left to safely turn it on.

data.label: Manual trigger - input is the search_code tool's JSON args
